aboutPage.title: User Guide
aboutPage.subtitle: Your Intelligent Investment Research Assistant
aboutPage.purposeText: "Super Digger" is an intelligent investment research tool designed to transform complex, unstructured financial news, research reports, or market themes into clear, multi-dimensional investment strategy analysis reports using cutting-edge AI technology. Our goal is to help investors save time, quickly grasp key information, discover potential investment opportunities, and understand the associated risks.
aboutPage.feature1: Four-Dimensional Integrated Analysis: Reports provide a comprehensive investment perspective by analyzing from four dimensions: macro & policy, industry & supply chain, company fundamentals, and market sentiment to help you find opportunities in US, HK, and A-share markets.
aboutPage.feature2: Structured Report Output: AI analysis results are presented in a structured format, making the content clear and easy to understand, moving away from lengthy and complex texts.
aboutPage.feature3: Data Visualization: Tools like industry chain diagrams and stock association graphs make data and relationships clear at a glance.
aboutPage.feature4: History & Playback: Automatically saves your analysis history for easy review and comparison at any time.
aboutPage.feature5: One-Click Export: Easily export complete analysis reports as high-fidelity images or HTML web reports for sharing and saving.
